Its fat header has maxstack 4 and local signature token 0x11001063 with blob 070312a788081287bc, declaring locals Player, Int32 and WrestlerVoiceAttr. The first 65 bytes reproduce the exact MatchMain/Fade fast-forward throttle shape already seen at FACT-0058: when MatchMain.inst is non-null, MatchMain.isFastForwardMatch is nonzero, FACT-0059 Fade.IsFadeFinish returns true, and unsigned MatchMain.MchFrameCnt % 20 is nonzero, the method returns; otherwise it continues. If Audience.inst is non-null, it then calls FACT-0183 WrestlerVoiceInfoManager.GetWrestlerVoiceAttr with local.WresParam.voiceType[SkillSlotID] and local.WresParam.voiceID[SkillSlotID], reads WrestlerVoiceAttr.cheerVoice, returns when that raw value equals -1, and otherwise calls FACT-0079 Audience.PlayCheerVoice(cheerVoice,4). FACT-0015 FormAnimator.PlayAnimationSE contains the DLL's only raw direct reference to Player.PlayWrestlerVoice, a callvirt at IL+0x008E on its raw seID 1 branch.
